name: ptcli-retorrent
description: AI-callable Chinese PT retorrent, upload, qBittorrent, and daily-candidate automation service.

safety.blocked_contract: When rules, duplicate checks, qBittorrent evidence, or required confirmations are missing, APIs return status=blocked with blockers and next_actions.

tools.name: retorrent_job
tools.description: Create an asynchronous retorrent job and return a job_id for polling long-running download, material, upload, and qBittorrent steps.

tools.name: daily_candidates_job
tools.description: Create an asynchronous daily-candidate discovery job and return a job_id for polling.

tools.name: get_job_status
tools.description: Return short AI-readable job status, blockers, next actions, duplicate check, summary file, and resume state.

tools.name: resume_job
tools.description: Create a follow-up job from the allowlisted next_command_argv generated by a blocked or failed job.
